What is the supply?
There are 500 total packs, with 5 cards per pack, equaling 2500 total cards.
How many packs can I purchase? What is the price?
5 packs max per wallet. Each pack costs $15
What is included in each pack? 
Each booster pack includes 5 cards. Cards in packs are randomized with varying rarities. Specific cards are not guaranteed. 
What are the rarity tiers and odds of pulling a specific card?
Common - 40%
Uncommon - 24%
Rare - 18%
Epic - 10%
Legendary - 6%

How many cards are in the complete set?
There are 35 unique designs in this first set.
